MOZ.note: Law only said to be in preparation; no draft or rule named.
The only tool named is an education tool, which is sectoral.
Minister says a law on AI in education is being prepared; no draft text named, so no fact.

facts.fact: Education and Culture Minister Edson Macuacua launched MAZA IA on 22 October 2026, an AI tool to support students and teachers, developed by MOZEDUCA with Vodacom Mocambique.
MAZA IA, an AI learning solution developed in Mozambique by MOZEDUCA with Vodacom Mocambique, was launched on 22 October 2026, and the minister urged national technology solutions.
